An unknown proportion of Checkers & Compute Providers allocation is released according to Reward Schedules. Here we have used the same 4 year linear unlock as the rest of this allocation.
Checker Node Rewards tracks ATH withdrawn after the claim vesting period; rewards earned but not yet claimed or still vesting are not included. Claim amounts are net of early-withdraw penalties.

Checker Node Rewards.methodology: Checker node rewards withdrawn on-chain. Rewards are earned off-chain as vATH, converted to ATH via a claim that starts a 180-day vesting period and withdrawn from the CheckerClaimAndWithdraw contract once vested.

checker-withdrawals.name: Checker Node Withdrawals
checker-withdrawals.methodology: Checker node rewards withdrawn on-chain. Rewards are earned off-chain as vATH, converted to ATH via a claim that starts a 180-day vesting period and withdrawn from the CheckerClaimAndWithdraw contract once vested.

Checkers & Compute Providers.methodology: 50% allocation to checker nodes and compute providers, minus checker withdrawals already tracked on-chain, released according to off-chain reward schedules.

checkers-compute-remainder.name: Checkers & Compute Providers (Remainder)
checkers-compute-remainder.methodology: 50% of supply minus on-chain checker withdrawals, modeled as a 4 year linear unlock as the actual release follows off-chain performance-based reward schedules.
